attempts.text:
**The window starts in the `eut` cluster.** Columns 0 to 28 are spine, carried by 92 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 17% of calls. The model names 86 to 99.6% of genes there, and its most hesitant column of the whole window is column 18, `eutB`, at 1.38 bits and 86% named. The `eut` genes, [[ethanolamine utilization microcompartments]], run through the middle of this stretch.

**A variable column interrupts at `pbp4b`**, column 29, in a region of plasticity in 4% of calls, named 88%, 0.76 bits. Then two spine columns, `murP` and `murQ`, [[N-acetylmuramic acid metabolism]], and another variable column, `murR`, named 98% with 0.11 bits.

**The long spine from `ucpA` to `yfeR`** holds 18 columns, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 1 to 17% of calls. Naming drops at column 36, `cysW`, to 52%, while the most hesitant column is 39, `yfeK`, at 0.42 bits. The `cys` genes there, [[sulfate and thiosulfate transport]], sit beside `ptsI` and `ptsH`.

**Columns 51 to 56 are variable**, in a region of plasticity in 28 to 57% of calls, the most plastic stretch of the window. The model still names 82 to 90% of genes, fewest at column 51, 82%. The families carried there, `flxA` to `xapR`, are all shell, carried by 25 to 68% of chromosomes.

**The window closes on forks.** Columns 57 to 61 are spine, named 81 to 90%, then column 62 is a fork, `hypothetical protein`, named 80%. Columns 63 to 68 are spine, named 91 to 96%, and columns 69 to 79 are fork and variable columns, named 93 to 97%, ending at `ypdI`, carried by 76% of chromosomes. Across the window the model names 94% of genes; inside a region of plasticity it names 78% against 95% outside, and hesitates 1.19 against 0.21 bits.

label: aegA
facts:
WINDOW: the aegA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor aegA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 1,248 to 1,327 from dnaA. Read in 532 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying aegA once); 42,560 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 94% of genes, 0.28 bits on average (perplexity 1.3 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 37,471 calls, named 97%, 0.19 bits; shell 4,728 calls, named 72%, 0.68 bits; cloud 361 calls, named 19%, 4.20 bits. Outside an RGP 39,394 calls, named 95%, 0.21 bits; inside an RGP 3,166 calls, named 78%, 1.19 bits. Columns: 60 spine, 3 fork, 17 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.19 against 0.21 bits) and names fewer genes (78% against 95%); 3,166 of the 42,560 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 18 (eutB) 1.38 bits, RGP 16%; column 29 (pbp4b) 0.76 bits, RGP 4%; column 63 (mntH) 0.57 bits, RGP 7%. The 3 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 89%, 0.40 bits on average; the other 77 columns: named 94%, 0.27 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 51-56 (variable), RGP 28-57%; the least: column 32 (variable), RGP 2%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-28 (29 columns) spine: share 92-100%, all P, RGP 0-17%. Genes: aegA, nudK, ypfG "DUF1176 domain-containing protein", tkt, tal, maeB, eutS, eutP "ethanolamine utilization acetate ki…", eutQ, eutT, pta, eutM "ethanolamine utilization microcompa…", eutN, eutE, eutJ, eutG, eutH, eutA, eutB, eutC, eutL, eutK, eutR, hemF, amiA, ypeA "GNAT family acetyltransferase", yfeZ "DUF2919 domain-containing protein", yfeY "DUF1131 family protein", yfeX "porphyrinogen peroxidase". named 86-99.6% (mean 96%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 18 (eutB), named 86%, 1.38 bits.
2. column 29 variable: RGP 4%. named 88%; 0.76 bits.
   29: pbp4b S 76%
3. columns 30-31 (2 columns) spine: share 92-96%, all P, RGP 2-3%. Genes: murP, murQ "N-acetylmuramic acid 6-phosphate et…". named 95-96% (mean 96%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 30 (murP), named 95%, 0.37 bits.
4. column 32 variable: RGP 2%. named 98%; 0.11 bits.
   32: murR S 86%
5. columns 33-50 (18 columns) spine: share 92-96%, all P, RGP 1-17%. Genes: ucpA, cysP, cysT, cysW, cysA "sulfate/thiosulfate ABC transporter…", cysM, yfeK "DUF5329 family protein", pdxK, crr, ptsI "phosphoenolpyruvate-protein phospho…", ptsH, cysK "pyridoxal-phosphate dependent enzyme", cysZ, zipA, ligA, ypeB "putative quorum-sensing-regulated v…", yfeH "bile acid:sodium symporter family p…", yfeR "LysR family transcriptional regulat…". named 52-99% (mean 92%), fewest named at column 36 (cysW), named 52%; most hesitant at column 39 (yfeK), 0.42 bits.
6. columns 51-56 (6 columns) variable: RGP 28-57%. named 82-90% (mean 88%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 51, named 82%, 0.47 bits.
   columns 51-56, share 25-68%, all S: flxA 25%, yfeN "outer membrane protein OmpK" 65%, xapA 68%, xapB "MFS transporter" 64%, "DUF1427 family protein" 68%, xapR 66%
7. columns 57-61 (5 columns) spine: share 92-95%, all P, RGP 3-7%. Genes: gltX, yfeD "YfeC-like transcriptional regulator", yfeC "YfeC-like transcriptional regulator", pdeA, nupC. named 81-90% (mean 87%), fewest named at column 61 (nupC), named 81%; most hesitant at column 58 (yfeD), 0.56 bits.
8. column 62 fork: RGP 6%. named 80%; 0.42 bits.
   62: "hypothetical protein" S 50%; also "hypothetical protein" S 23%
9. columns 63-68 (6 columns) spine: share 91-95%, all P, RGP 2-7%. Genes: mntH, ypeC "DUF2502 domain-containing protein Y…", yfeO "ion channel protein", glk, fryB "PTS fructose transporter subunit IIB", fryC. named 91-96% (mean 95%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 63 (mntH), named 91%, 0.57 bits.
10. columns 69-79 (11 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 2-4%. named 93-97% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 72, named 93%; most hesitant at column 71, 0.35 bits.
   columns 69-77 variable, share 82-89%, all P: ypdF "aminopeptidase" 89%, ypdE "aminopeptidase" 89%, ptsP 85%, ypdC "helix-turn-helix transcriptional re…" 82%, ypdB "two-component system response regul…" 86%, ypdA "two-component system sensor histidi…" 84%, alaC 85%, ypdK "membrane protein YpdK" 84%, lpxP 83%
   78 fork: yfdY P 82% "YfdY family protein"; also frc P 44%, yfdV P 26%
   79 fork: ypdI P 76% "colanic acid biosynthesis lipoprote…"; also yfdX P 59%, oxc P 38%, yfdE P 18%
PRODUCTS of named genes (for [[ ]]): eutS ethanolamine utilization microcompartme…; eutQ ethanolamine utilization acetate kinase…; eutT ethanolamine utilization cob(I)yrinic a…; eutN ethanolamine utilization microcompartme…; eutE aldehyde dehydrogenase family protein; eutJ ethanolamine utilization protein EutJ; eutH ethanolamine utilization protein EutH; eutA ethanolamine ammonia-lyase reactivating…; eutB ethanolamine ammonia-lyase subunit alpha; eutC ethanolamine ammonia-lyase light chain…; eutR helix-turn-helix domain-containing prot…; murP PTS transporter subunit EIIC; murR HTH-type transcriptional regulator MurR; cysP thiosulfate/sulfate ABC transporter sub…; cysT ABC transporter permease subunit; cysM cysteine synthase B; ptsH HPr family phosphocarrier protein; cysZ sulfate transporter CysZ; fryC PTS fructose transporter subunit IIC; frc CoA transferase; yfdV AEC family transporter; yfdE CoA transferase
END: the window ends at column 79, ypdI, in 76% of chromosomes.
